about: The source model of an Akoya (PerkinElmer) QPTIFF file (spec/zarrify/qptiff.md <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/qptiff.md>, spec/zarrify/qptiff.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/qptiff.md#7-qptiff-profile>): a TIFF or BigTIFF whose main chain holds the channels as FullResolution images, a Thumbnail, the ReducedResolution images of each pyramid level, and an Overview and a Label, each IFD described by a PerkinElmer-QPI-ImageDescription XML in its ImageDescription. The TIFF parser reads it in its QPTIFF variant (rust/refkv-ir/src/tiff.rs) and checks this schema where the profile meets each role; projections read a valid IR and check nothing. The TIFF source model's elements (schema/tiff.json) are this one's.

kinds.about: the field types a tag of each kind may have (TIFF 6.0 §2, BigTIFF)

tags.about: The tags of the table (spec/zarrify/qptiff.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/qptiff.md#2-the-source>): kind (the field types allowed), scalar (the first value is read, and there must be one), used (read for every main-chain IFD; ImageDescription for every main-chain IFD, SubIFDs where followed).

elements.about:
The IR of a QPTIFF file: the TIFF source model's (schema/tiff.json), without `ome/planes/

`. Names in angle brackets are variables; `run` marks where a parser folds consecutive identically shaped siblings into one run.

ifds/<i>.about: the main chain; each IFD's SubIFDs are subifds/<j> (to depth 4), and the IFDs other pointer tags lead to are exif, gps, interoperability or ifd_<tag> (/<j> when the tag has several values; an IFD read before is an alias)

children.tags/<tag>: struct of entry {tag,type,count[,offset][,field]} and value (in the value field, or at its offset: decoded when the profile reads it, or when small); a duplicate tag is tags/<tag>~<k>
children.tiles/<k>: data (run): a tile of TileOffsets and TileByteCounts with a byte count above 0 within the file; geometry, codec and recipe (a JPEG tile's recipe puts the IFD's JPEG prefix, a shared data source, after its first 2 bytes); an IFD whose tile tables are an earlier IFD's names its tiles by alias
children.strips/<k>: data (run): the same, for StripOffsets and StripByteCounts; a level in strips references them as its chunks

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: detection (spec/zarrify/qptiff.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/qptiff.md#7-qptiff-profile>: the first IFD's Software tag, ASCII, starting with `PerkinElmer-QPI`; it never rejects); the main chain (each next offset until 0) and the SubIFDs depth first to max_depth; each main-chain IFD's PerkinElmer-QPI-ImageDescription (ASCII, up to its first NUL, valid UTF-8, the root element's direct children ImageType, Name, Color and SlideID); the channels (the FullResolution images at the start of the chain) and the levels (runs of as many ReducedResolution images, in chain order); the format tuple (bits, samples, sample format, planar, compression, predictor, and photometric for JPEG); each level's tiling (tiled, or strips of RowsPerStrip rows); the JPEG prefix (an Adobe APP14 marker for 3 samples, then JPEGTables without its SOI and EOI).
